cases.name: an unlocked Windows interactive desktop owns the real product Chrome and native IME
real pinyin composition shows the OS candidate window over the Monaco editor
arrow selection followed by a real Space commit inserts exactly the selected Chinese candidate
a real Escape cancel leaves no pinyin, no lost or duplicated text, and focus remains in Monaco
real pinyin composition and Space commit fill the question draft exactly once without dropped characters
a real Escape cancels question-draft composition without changing text, sending or running
the ALU experiment prepared and the real run control is enabled
the real run succeeded and enabled the current work
running and the full check never clear or send the question draft
an illegal numeric draft (-1) stays in the field and is marked aria-invalid
Escape cancel keeps the original illegal draft; aria-invalid, ports and simulation count are unchanged
a committed Chinese candidate in the numeric field is invalid and triggers no simulation
Monaco composition followed by ALU-tab switch and back keeps text and focus correct
switching between the numeric input and the question draft does not leak or leave text behind
new prediction reason accepts native Chinese, cancels without residue and survives active-composition navigation
new explanation accepts/cancels native Chinese and saves an immutable revision without running or sending
